# SAM AI - Master Resource Index

> AI-powered business automation platform built on Odoo 18.
> This file helps AI assistants navigate the SAM AI ecosystem.

## Quick Start

**What is SAM AI?**
SAM (Smart Automation Manager) is an AI-powered business automation platform that helps small businesses operate more efficiently. Built on Odoo 18, it combines intelligent chat interfaces, workflow automation, and modular business tools.

**Navigation Guide:**
1. Start here (llms.txt) for ecosystem overview
2. Go to /insights/llms.txt for technical documentation
3. Go to /agents/llms.txt for agent configurations

## Resource Map

| Resource | URL | Purpose |

## For Technical Questions

**Fetch:** https://ai-sam-ai.github.io/insights/llms.txt

Topics covered:
- Module documentation (18+ Odoo modules)
- Architecture and data flows
- API specifications
- Development guides
- System prompts and prompt engineering

**Key modules:**
- `ai_sam` - Core chat interface
- `ai_sam_base` - Backend infrastructure
- `ai_sam_workflows` - N8N-style workflow automation
- `ai_sam_intelligence` - Agent registry and documentation intelligence

## For Agent Configuration

**Fetch:** https://ai-sam-ai.github.io/agents/index.json

Available agents:
- `sales-agent` (active) - Landing page sales conversations
- `support-agent` (planned) - Client support
- `onboarding-agent` (planned) - New client onboarding

**Loading pattern:**
1. Fetch /agents/index.json for registry
2. Match user context to agent triggers
3. Load full config from /agents/{id}/agent.json
4. Load knowledge files as needed

## Key Endpoints

### Documentation
- `/insights/` - Documentation home
- `/insights/llms.txt` - AI navigation guide
- `/insights/docs/04_modules/` - Module reference
- `/insights/docs/05_how_sam_works/` - Architecture

### Agents
- `/agents/` - Agent registry home
- `/agents/index.json` - Machine-readable registry
- `/agents/llms.txt` - AI navigation guide
- `/agents/sales-agent/agent.json` - Sales agent config

## Platform Overview

**Stack:**
- Backend: Odoo 18 (Python)
- Frontend: OWL Framework (Odoo Web Library)
- AI: Claude API integration
- Workflows: N8N-style visual automation
- Deployment: Docker-based SaaS

**Core Capabilities:**
- Intelligent chat interfaces embedded in business workflows
- Visual workflow builder with AI-powered nodes
- Multi-tenant SaaS architecture
- Modular addon system
